steps.content: You remain devoid of control, drifting wherever chaos takes you.
At some point, a girl's silhouette emerges within your sight. With a pair of transparent wings and a tangible form, she seems strong enough to soar against the tides of chaos.
She flies about anxiously, seemingly in search of something.
Eventually, her gaze settles upon you.
She alights beside you and folds her wings, letting them dissipate into particles of shimmering light.
Light enters you once more. Gradually, you begin to sense your own existence: hands, feet—you regain a physical form, no longer a mere grain of sand drifting along the currents.
You turn around the very moment when your senses return to you, but the girl is nowhere to be found.
All that remains is a tiny green insect, emitting incomprehensible rustling sounds as it longingly circles around you before vanishing once again into the darkness.
